last_assistant_message:
Done. The deck is built, branded, and verified.

**Deliverable:** `/Users/davidohara/Library/CloudStorage/OneDrive-Improving/Presentations/AI/What AI Makes Possible in Banking.pptx` — 32 slides, 16:9, 2.0 MB, full speaker notes on every slide.

**How it was built**
- Base: Improving brand template (`Starter - Original.potx` via the OneDrive `Presentations/Starter/` sync, since the Group Containers path is sandbox-blocked). Example slides stripped with the pptx skill's clean.py, keeping masters/layouts and the brand theme (Calibri Light headings, Calibri body, brand palette 005596/4597D3/FF9300/5BC2A7/F5BB41).
- Slide 1 uses the branded Principal Title layout (logo, presenter name); the five concept dividers plus slides 30 and 32 use the gradient Titlte Page layout with a gold-ring numeral motif that repeats as concept chips on content slides; content slides sit on the brand Text Slide layout.
- One native chart (slide 21, MIT Sloan 85/94/73 success-rate columns, full-autonomy bar in orange). Slide 20's invest-ahead vs retrofit curves are drawn as labeled illustrative lines, marked "Illustrative cost profile" since they carry no data.

**Guardrails — all verified programmatically on the final file**
- No bank/platform/customer/person names, no "charter," no legislation names, no year-like numbers on any slide. UBPR report dates (6/30/2026) live only in speaker notes as data-vintage citations, per the resolved open question 1.
- Slide 18 carries David's generic payback claim ("under 20 months of operation on an 18-month build, est."); the honesty note about deposit funding value being the business case is in the speaker notes. No private timeline facts anywhere.
- All case figures labeled "est."; assumption arithmetic included in the notes for slides 6, 7, 9, 11, 18 exactly as resolved.
- No em-dashes or en-dashes in slides or notes (per standing feedback rule).
- Slide 32's dual-perspective line "I've seen this built." is in the speaker notes only, not on the slide.

**QA performed:** schema validation passed; text dump confirmed all 32 slides in correct order with no missing content; full visual QA via PowerPoint PDF export (true brand fonts) with every slide inspected. Five defects found and fixed: mid-word node labels on the six-component ring (slide 29), a marker dot colliding with text (slide 23), a missing rotated axis label (slide 28), a redundant "legacy" in the slide 7 comparison rows, and a curve label touching its line (slide 20). Fixed slides re-rendered and confirmed clean.
